name: PLAG1 like zinc finger 2
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: PLAGL2 encodes zinc finger protein PLAGL2. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include CNS embryonal tumor with PLAG family gene alteration. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports copy-number alteration context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.
